messages.content: How do I open an Airtel Payments Bank savings account?

To open an Airtel Payments Bank savings account, you can follow these steps:

1. Open the Airtel Thanks app on your mobile device.
2. Go to the banking wallet section and select 'Open Account'.
3. Follow the guided prompts to input your personal details and verify the request using an OTP sent to your phone.
4. Alternatively, you can also open a savings account in person by visiting an authorized Airtel Payments Bank retail banking point.

Please note that you will need to provide your permanent Aadhaar Card number and a valid PAN Card as part of the KYC process [Source 5].
